templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
templates.description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, capturing the deal-specific terms (purpose, effective date, MNDA term, confidentiality term, governing law, jurisdiction) and signatures. Incorporates the Mutual NDA Standard Terms by reference.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
templates.description: Standard terms for a mutual NDA allowing both parties to share confidential information for an evaluation or business relationship, covering use and protection obligations, exceptions, required disclosures, term, and return of information.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for selling and buying SaaS / cloud software, covering access and use, restrictions, fees and payment, warranties, liability limits, indemnification, confidentiality, and term and termination.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for licensing on-premise or installed software, covering the license grant, restrictions, support, fees, warranties, liability, indemnification, and termination.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for engaging a provider to perform professional services under statements of work (SOWs), covering deliverables, acceptance, fees, intellectual property, warranties, and liability.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms governing the processing of personal data by a provider on behalf of a customer, covering controller/processor roles, subprocessors, security, data subject requests, breach notification, and international transfers (GDPR-aligned).

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: Standard HIPAA business associate agreement setting out how a provider may use, disclose, and safeguard protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity customer.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Standard service level terms for a cloud service, defining target uptime, target response times for support, service credits, and exclusions.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum to a cloud service or software agreement covering the use of AI services, including inputs and outputs, ownership, training restrictions, and customer responsibilities for AI-generated content.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for a limited-time trial or pilot of a product before a full purchase, covering pilot access, term and termination, warranty disclaimers, limited liability, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for an early-stage design partnership where a partner gets early product access in exchange for feedback, covering access, fees and costs, confidentiality, intellectual property, and term.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for a business partnership between two companies (e.g., referral, reseller, or integration partnerships), covering each party's obligations, trademark use, fees, confidentiality, and termination.
